dedupe_keys.name: china hourly climate and renewable generation projections across five models and four ssps

description: The China climate and renewable-energy team publishes hourly projections of weather and wind and photovoltaic generation for power-system studies. Twenty Zenodo deposits divide one named dataset into five global climate models and four shared socioeconomic pathways because of repository size limits. The article states China coverage from 2021 to 2060 at about 0.5-degree resolution. The own metadata list NetCDF climate variables in decade files; the describing paper also identifies MAT generation outputs. Each current deposit states CC BY 4.0 and public access is free. These scenarios can drive capacity and resilience simulations using a separate network model such as model-pypsa. A caveat is that projected generation depends on climate-model, downscaling and conversion assumptions; a model-scenario component must not be mistaken for an observed time series. All twenty component DOIs are retained as access links. Metadata and manifests were read without downloading grids or reproducing the conversion.

notes: G1 G1-0532. Metadata-only verification; no data files or software archives downloaded or executed. Comparison evidence: evidence/dedupe-batch-38.json. Related-resource uses are not tested interfaces. This one named dataset was split across twenty Zenodo DOI components; every component is listed in access_links and sources. Components differ by climate model and SSP for China, and by region, time and resolution for UFLUX.
